CustomField.description: The Travel Costs incurred for the performance. If the travelling distance is less than 100km, this fee is waived. Fee is rounded down to the nearest 10
CustomField.formula: IF(Travel_fee_not_Applicable__c,0, (10 * FLOOR( IF( ISPICKVAL(Travelling_By__c, 'Road'), IF( Travelling_Distance__c > 100, Travelling_Distance__c * Artist__r.Travel_Fee__c, 0 ), Flights__r.Total_Price__c/2 ) / 10 ))*2)
CustomField.label: Artist Travel Costs
